storyPrompts: Thousands of miles away from home, and a new story has just begun. Hello, Shanghai.
My first city stamp in China. Here’s to getting a little lost and finding something wonderful.
A new skyline, a new chapter. My China story begins in Shanghai.

samplePosts.author: _TI***fl
samplePosts.title: Shanghai is a cyberpunk city
samplePosts.body: As soon as I arrived in Shanghai, I rushed to The Stage at White Magnolia Plaza. The Stage is really underrated. It's a 360° open-air observation deck at an altitude of 320m, where you can see the Huangpu River, the Bund, and Lujiazui all at once. It feels completely different from the usual view of Shanghai from the Bund—it's like unlocking a new perspective on the city.…

samplePosts.author: Babysaruda
samplePosts.title: "1000 Trees Shanghai"—A Must-Visit Epic Photo Spot.
samplePosts.body: 🌿 A lush landmark right in the heart of the city! "1000 Trees Shanghai" is an epic photo spot you absolutely have to check out. If you're heading to Shanghai and looking for a totally unique location, you need to pin "1000 Trees." This ultra-futuristic building looks just like a mountain covered in thousands of cascading trees. Sitting right next to Suzhou Creek, it perfectly…

samplePosts.author: Meowsvacation
samplePosts.title: Crazy good value 24 hour spa in Shanghai!
samplePosts.body: This is one of the best-value 24-hour spas that I’ve found in Shanghai. For $40 USD, you get 8 hours of access, including buffet meal plus unlimited fruit, drinks, and ice cream. And unlike many of the viral luxury spas, where meals can cost extra, food is already included here. The buffet isn’t lobster-and-caviar level, but there’s still plenty: crawfish, clams, fish,…

samplePosts.author: Crazy.traveler เที่ยวจะเครซี่
samplePosts.title: Shanghai Warehouse No.3: A Futuristic Space-Themed Restaurant
samplePosts.body: Located at Shanghai No.3 Warehouse (上海3号仓库餐厅) on Songze Avenue in Xujing Town, this unique dining spot can be found on the 4th floor (Roof Garden). To reach it, you need to take the escalator from the 3rd floor. 🚇 Easy to get there: Take Line 17 to Xu Ying Road Station (徐盈路), exit at Exit 4, and it's just a short walk away.
